app.name: Slack
app.review_note: Checked against provider sources on 2 November 2026; corrections are listed in VERIFICATION.md.

summary.headline: Create a Slack app, set redirect URLs and scopes, and install it in your workspace right away. Apps outside the Slack Marketplace get much tighter rate limits on reading channel history.
summary.type_note: Building and installing in your own workspace is self-serve. Marketplace approval is needed for normal rate limits on conversation history and for listing publicly.

difficulty_factors.reason: Requires logging into a Slack account to access the app management portal.
Marketplace submission is reviewed; internal and workspace apps are not.
Workspace installation is quick, but no review turnaround for the Marketplace is published.
Creating a Slack app and testing OAuth does not require a paid plan.
Requires human login to the Slack developer dashboard.

approval_wait.label: Marketplace review time not published; own-workspace use needs no approval (not independently checked)

can_start_today.reason: You can view documentation and the app creation portal immediately, but logging in and creating credentials requires a human user account.

confidence.reason: OAuth setup and rate-limit changes come from Slack's documentation and changelog; Marketplace timing and exact scope definitions were not found.

blockers.title: Lower rate limits for apps outside the Marketplace
blockers.detail: Slack's changelog says apps not approved for the Marketplace are limited to 1 request per minute and 15 objects per request on conversations.history and conversations.replies, for new apps from 29 May 2025 and later for existing unlisted installs.
blockers.workaround: Get Marketplace approval, or avoid these two methods if your agent can.

blockers.title: Marketplace submission requires active workspace installs
blockers.detail: Slack's changelog describes a minimum number of active-workspace installs before an app can be submitted (10, later reduced to 5). The current number was not confirmed.
blockers.workaround: Check the current requirement in the Marketplace guidelines before planning a launch.

blockers.title: You must sign in to create an app
blockers.detail: Creating and managing Slack apps needs a Slack user account.
blockers.workaround: Sign in to the Slack API site with your account.

steps.title: Create a Slack App
steps.action: Go to the Slack API apps page, sign in, and click 'Create New App'.
steps.why_human_only: Requires authentication with a Slack account.

steps.title: Configure OAuth Redirect URLs
steps.action: Navigate to 'OAuth & Permissions' in your app settings and add your redirect URL.

steps.title: Add Scopes
steps.action: Under 'OAuth & Permissions', add the required Bot or User token scopes for your agent.

steps.title: If you distribute to other workspaces, prepare a Marketplace submission
steps.action: Check Slack's current Marketplace requirements (including the minimum active installs) and submit through your app settings. Review time is not published.

scopes.purpose: View basic information about public channels in a workspace
Send messages on behalf of the app

common_rejection_reasons.reason: Redirect URI mismatch during the OAuth handshake (an error, not a review rejection)
common_rejection_reasons.fix: Make the redirect URL in the Slack app dashboard match the callback URL your application sends exactly.
